recipes.title: Fragrant Toasted Sichuan Pepper & Scallion Soft Eggs
recipes.summary: Cloud-soft scrambled eggs scented delicately with scallions, light rice bran oil, toasted sesame oil, and a bright citrusy pinch of toasted ground Sichuan pepper.

ingredient_details.item: lightly toasted finely ground Sichuan peppercorn husks

steps: Whisk eggs with 1 tbsp water, half the scallions, and a light pinch of salt.
Warm oil over medium-low heat and fold eggs gently 2 to 3 minutes until soft moist curds set.
Plate warm and finish with toasted sesame oil, remaining scallions, and 1/8 tsp toasted finely ground Sichuan pepper.
tips: Dry-toasting Sichuan peppercorns 1 minute and grinding finely yields bright lemon-blossom aroma with only a gentle refreshing tingle—zero chili heat.
Always start with 1/8 teaspoon so the floral citrus aroma stays delicate.

recipes.title: Warm Ginger, Scallion & Sichuan Pepper Rice Congee
recipes.summary: Soothing silky rice porridge simmered in savory broth with fresh ginger, topped with scallions, sesame oil, and citrusy toasted ground Sichuan pepper.
steps: Simmer cooked rice, broth, and grated ginger in a saucepan 15 minutes until thick and porridge-soft.
Ladle into two warm bowls and drizzle with toasted sesame oil.
Finish each bowl with sliced scallions and a delicate sprinkle of toasted finely ground Sichuan pepper.
tips: Sichuan pepper belongs to the citrus family—its floral lemony lift wakes up cozy warm porridge without adding chili burn.
Ultra-soft and comforting for calm mornings.

recipes.title: Citrus-Floral Sichuan Pepper Stewed Pears & Greek Yogurt
recipes.summary: Pastry-chef inspired soft diced pears gently simmered with honey, orange zest, and a subtle floral pinch of toasted ground Sichuan pepper over yogurt.

ingredient_details.item: fresh orange zest plus 2 tbsp juice

steps: Simmer diced pears with orange juice, 2 tbsp water, honey, orange zest, and 1/8 tsp toasted ground Sichuan pepper 9 minutes until velvety soft.
Spoon cool plain Greek yogurt into two bowls.
Pile the fragrant floral stewed pears and juices over the yogurt.
tips: Because Sichuan peppercorn is a botanical cousin of citrus, a gentle pinch turns poached pears wonderfully aromatic and bright.
Effortless to spoon and swallow.

recipes.title: Smashed Avocado, Lime & Toasted Sichuan Pepper Toast
recipes.summary: Warm whole-grain toast spread with cool mashed avocado, fresh lime juice, toasted sesame seeds, and a floral citrus pinch of Sichuan pepper.
steps: Mash ripe avocado smoothly with fresh lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Spread thick onto warm whole-grain toast.
Finish with a tiny drizzle of olive oil, toasted sesame seeds, and 1/8 tsp toasted ground Sichuan pepper.
tips: Rich buttery avocado balances Sichuan pepper's sparkling citrus perfume smoothly.
Ready in 7 minutes with zero stovetop work.

recipes.title: Whipped Ricotta, Strawberries & Sichuan Pepper Honey Toast
recipes.summary: Crisp whole-grain toast layered with cool ricotta, sweet sliced strawberries, and honey whisked with a tiny lemon-floral pinch of toasted Sichuan pepper.
steps: Stir 1/8 tsp toasted finely ground Sichuan pepper smoothly into honey.
Spread warm toasted whole-grain bread with cool ricotta and layer sweet sliced strawberries on top.
Drizzle the fragrant floral honey across both slices.
tips: Works just like classic strawberries and black pepper, with an extra floral mandarin-peel lift.
High in morning protein and completely mild.

recipes.title: Chilled Sesame, Cucumber & Mild Sichuan Pepper Soba Bowl
recipes.summary: Nutty chilled buckwheat noodles tossed with crisp cucumber, shelled edamame, sesame-soy-vinegar dressing, and aromatic toasted ground Sichuan pepper.
steps: Boil soba noodles 5 to 6 minutes until tender, rinse cold, and drain thoroughly.
Whisk soy sauce, rice vinegar, toasted sesame oil, 2 tbsp water, and 1/4 tsp toasted ground Sichuan pepper.
Toss chilled noodles, cucumber, and edamame with the fragrant citrusy sesame dressing and serve cool.
tips: All the refreshing floral magic of Sichuan cold noodles (liangmian) without fiery chili oil.
Snip noodles briefly with kitchen shears for easy fork bites.

recipes.title: Silken Tofu, Crisp Cucumber & Sichuan Pepper Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Cool custard-soft silken tofu and diced cucumber plated over warm rice with ginger, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and toasted Sichuan pepper.
steps: Whisk soy sauce, rice vinegar, toasted sesame oil, 1 tbsp water, and 1/4 tsp toasted ground Sichuan pepper.
Place warm rice in two bowls and arrange soft silken tofu and diced cucumber over top.
Spoon the fragrant citrus-sesame dressing gently across both bowls and eat with a spoon.
tips: No stove heat required, custard-soft texture, and gently uplifting citrusy aroma.
Scatter sliced scallions or fresh cilantro over top.

recipes.title: Mild Sichuan-Style Poached Chicken, Cabbage & Mandarin Salad
recipes.summary: Shredded poached chicken, tender shredded Napa cabbage, and sweet mandarin segments tossed in sesame-lime dressing scented with toasted Sichuan pepper.
steps: Whisk rice vinegar, toasted sesame oil, grated ginger, 1 tsp honey, 1/4 tsp toasted ground Sichuan pepper, and a pinch of salt.
Toss shredded Napa cabbage and shredded poached chicken gently with the dressing.
Fold in sweet juicy orange segments right before serving.
tips: Sweet orange segments echo the citrus aroma of toasted Sichuan peppercorns effortlessly.
Zero chili heat and ready in 8 minutes.

recipes.title: Aromatic Mushroom, Bok Choy & Sichuan Pepper Noodle Soup
recipes.summary: Clear, soothing plant-based broth simmering shiitake mushrooms, baby bok choy, ginger, thin rice noodles, and fragrant toasted Sichuan pepper.
steps: Simmer vegetable broth, sliced mushrooms, grated ginger, soy sauce, and toasted ground Sichuan pepper 6 minutes until fragrant.
Add thin rice noodles and chopped baby bok choy and simmer 3 to 4 minutes until tender.
Ladle steaming into deep bowls and finish with a drop of toasted sesame oil.
tips: A cozy, clean broth soup with subtle floral-citrus lift and zero heavy oil.
Add cubed soft tofu or poached chicken if you'd like extra protein.

recipes.title: Honey, Orange & Sichuan Pepper Roasted Carrot Quinoa Bowl
recipes.summary: Caramelized sweet carrots roasted with olive oil, honey, and toasted ground Sichuan pepper over fluffy quinoa, chickpeas, and baby spinach.
steps: Heat oven to 400 F; toss sliced carrots with olive oil, honey, and 1/4 tsp toasted ground Sichuan pepper on a parchment-lined pan.
Roast 18 minutes until sweet, fork-tender, and fragrant.
Divide baby spinach, warm quinoa, and chickpeas between two bowls and pile the glazed citrus-spiced carrots on top.
tips: Squeeze fresh lemon or orange over the warm bowl right before serving.
Plant-based, gluten-free, and fiber-rich.

recipes.title: Orange, Ginger & Toasted Sichuan Pepper Baked Salmon
recipes.summary: Moist baked salmon fillets glazed with sweet orange juice, soy sauce, honey, grated ginger, and floral toasted ground Sichuan pepper alongside broccoli.

ingredient_details.item: freshly squeezed orange juice plus 1/2 tsp zest

steps: Heat oven to 400 F; whisk orange juice, orange zest, soy sauce, honey, grated ginger, and 1/4 tsp toasted ground Sichuan pepper.
Arrange lightly oiled broccoli florets on one side of a parchment-lined pan and salmon fillets on the other, brushing salmon generously with the glaze.
Bake 12 to 14 minutes until salmon flakes effortlessly and broccoli is tender.
tips: Citrus-blossom Sichuan pepper and fresh orange lift rich omega-3 salmon cleanly with zero fiery heat.
Serve over warm jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Mild Fragrant Sichuan Pepper Chicken & Green Beans
recipes.summary: Gentle twist on classic Sichuan green beans and chicken—using aromatic toasted ground Sichuan pepper, garlic, ginger, and light soy glaze without hot chiles.

ingredient_details.note: mixed with 3 tbsp water and 1 tsp honey

steps: Saute chicken pieces in oil over medium-high heat 5 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Add green beans and 3 tbsp water, cover, and steam-saute 4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Stir in garlic, grated ginger, toasted ground Sichuan pepper, and soy-honey sauce for 2 minutes until glossy and fragrant.
tips: Briefly covering the skillet softens green beans so they stay bright yet comfortable to chew.
Serve over warm steamed rice.

recipes.title: Velvety Mild Mapo-Style Tofu, Mushroom & Sichuan Pepper
recipes.summary: Comforting chile-free homage to Sichuan braised tofu: silky soft tofu and finely diced mushrooms simmered in savory ginger-miso-soy broth scented with toasted Sichuan pepper.

ingredient_details.item: finely diced cremini or shiitake mushrooms

steps: Saute finely diced mushrooms in 1 tbsp oil 4 minutes until browned, then stir in garlic and grated ginger 45 seconds.
Pour in vegetable broth, soy sauce, and gently slide in soft tofu cubes; simmer softly 5 minutes.
Turn off heat, dust with toasted finely ground Sichuan pepper and sliced scallions, and spoon over steaming rice.
tips: Silky soft tofu and finely diced mushrooms require almost zero chewing while delivering savory, citrus-floral umami.
100% plant-based and mild on sensitive stomachs.

recipes.title: Ginger, Bok Choy & Sichuan Pepper Pork Rice Noodles
recipes.summary: Tender thin-sliced pork tenderloin, baby bok choy, and springy rice noodles tossed in a bright mild soy-sesame sauce finished with toasted Sichuan pepper.

ingredient_details.note: thinly sliced into tender bite-size strips

steps: Stir-fry thin pork strips in 1 tbsp oil 4 minutes until just cooked through (145 F), then add baby bok choy and garlic for 2 minutes until tender.
Toss in drained soaked rice noodles, soy sauce, and 3 tbsp water for 2 minutes until evenly coated.
Turn off heat, fold in toasted sesame oil and toasted finely ground Sichuan pepper, and serve warm.
tips: Snip soaked rice noodles once or twice with kitchen shears before tossing so they twirl cleanly.
Lean, gluten-free, and quick.

recipes.title: Steamed Cod in Ginger, Orange & Sichuan Pepper Broth
recipes.summary: Melt-in-your-mouth cod fillets poached gently in light ginger-orange broth with baby spinach and a sparkling finish of toasted ground Sichuan pepper.
steps: Simmer vegetable broth, orange juice, and grated ginger 2 minutes in a wide skillet.
Lower heat, nestle cod fillets into the simmering citrus broth, cover, and gently poach 8 minutes until flaky.
Wilt baby spinach in the pan 1 minute, plate in shallow bowls over rice, and finish with toasted sesame oil and a delicate pinch of toasted ground Sichuan pepper.
tips: Ultra-gentle flaky texture with bright citrus fragrance.
Dairy-free and calming for evening meals.

recipes.title: Golden Mango, Orange & Floral Sichuan Pepper Smoothie
recipes.summary: Sunny citrus-floral smoothie blending frozen sweet mango, fresh orange juice, plain Greek yogurt, banana, and a tiny toasted pinch of Sichuan pepper.

ingredient_details.item: tiny pinch (1/16 tsp) toasted finely ground Sichuan pepper

steps: Combine orange juice, Greek yogurt, frozen mango, ripe banana, and 1/16 tsp toasted finely ground Sichuan pepper in a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until lush golden and completely smooth.
Pour into a chilled glass and enjoy immediately.
tips: Just 1/16 tsp toasted finely ground Sichuan pepper makes sweet mango and orange taste extra citrusy and floral with no spice burn.
High-protein and ready in 4 minutes.

recipes.title: Sweet Strawberry, Vanilla & Sichuan Pepper Yogurt Smoothie
recipes.summary: Artisan patisserie-inspired berry shake combining frozen strawberries, plain Greek yogurt, milk, vanilla, honey, and a delicate citrus-floral pinch of Sichuan pepper.

ingredient_details.item: tiny pinch (1/16 tsp) toasted finely ground Sichuan pepper

steps: Add milk, Greek yogurt, frozen strawberries, vanilla, honey, and 1/16 tsp toasted finely ground Sichuan pepper to a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until rosy pink and velvety.
Serve cold right away.
tips: French pastry chefs adore pairing strawberries with toasted Sichuan pepper for its bright yuzu-like perfume.
Smooth, uplifting, and gentle.

recipes.title: Zesty Pineapple, Ginger & Sichuan Pepper Citrus Smoothie
recipes.summary: Crisp dairy-free tropical refresher blending frozen pineapple, banana, coconut water, fresh lime, ginger, and a tiny floral pinch of toasted Sichuan pepper.

ingredient_details.item: tiny pinch (1/16 tsp) toasted finely ground Sichuan pepper

steps: Place coconut water, frozen pineapple, banana, lime juice, grated ginger, and 1/16 tsp toasted finely ground Sichuan pepper in a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until frothy yellow and completely smooth.
Pour into a chilled glass and enjoy.
tips: Hydrating, bright, and caffeine-free.
Sichuan pepper amplifies the sparkling citrus finish of lime and pineapple.

recipes.title: Sweet Pear, Rolled Oat & Floral Sichuan Pepper Smoothie
recipes.summary: Velvety dairy-free orchard smoothie combining peeled ripe pear, rolled oats, oat milk, lemon zest, honey, and a delicate pinch of toasted Sichuan pepper.

ingredient_details.item: tiny pinch (1/16 tsp) toasted finely ground Sichuan pepper

steps: Combine oat milk, rolled oats, diced peeled pear, lemon zest, honey, 1/16 tsp toasted finely ground Sichuan pepper, and 4 ice cubes in a blender.
Blend 55 seconds until creamy and completely smooth.
Serve chilled immediately.
tips: Delicate sweet pear and floral citrus-pepper taste refined and calm.
Whole-grain fiber and zero dairy.

recipes.title: Dark Cocoa, Sweet Orange & Sichuan Pepper Velvet Shake
recipes.summary: Chocolatier-inspired smoothie blending frozen banana, unsweetened cocoa powder, oat milk, fresh orange zest, and a subtle whisper of toasted Sichuan pepper.

ingredient_details.item: tiny pinch (1/16 tsp) toasted finely ground Sichuan pepper

steps: Place oat milk, frozen banana, cocoa powder, fresh orange zest, and 1/16 tsp toasted finely ground Sichuan pepper in a blender.
Blend 50 seconds until thick, rich, and velvety.
Pour into a chilled glass and enjoy.
tips: Chocolate, orange, and toasted Sichuan pepper are a celebrated gourmet chocolate-bar combination.
Dairy-free and naturally sweetened by ripe banana.

recipes.title: Sparkling Sweet Orange & Steeped Sichuan Pepper Press
recipes.summary: Crisp citrus mocktail layering freshly squeezed sweet orange juice, a clear strained toasted Sichuan pepper infusion, and plain sparkling water.

ingredient_details.item: lightly toasted crushed Sichuan peppercorn husks

steps: Steep lightly toasted crushed Sichuan peppercorn husks in 1/4 cup hot water 4 minutes, then strain through a fine tea filter.
Pour the clear floral infusion and freshly squeezed orange juice over ice cubes.
Top with sparkling water, stir once gently, and serve crisp.
tips: Steeping and fine-straining extracts pure citrus-blossom aroma with zero sediment and zero harshness.
Tastes like an elevated zero-proof botanical aperitif.

recipes.title: Cool Cucumber, Lime & Sichuan Pepper Spa Tonic
recipes.summary: Ultra-clean garden refresher combining fresh pressed cucumber juice, bright lime, honey, and chilled strained toasted Sichuan pepper infusion.

ingredient_details.item: lightly toasted crushed Sichuan peppercorn husks

steps: Steep toasted crushed Sichuan pepper husks in 1/3 cup hot water 4 minutes, strain cleanly, and dissolve honey while warm.
Pour the fragrant clear infusion, fresh cucumber juice, and lime juice over ice cubes.
Stir gently and sip cold.
tips: Cooling cucumber and bright lime frame Sichuan pepper's floral-lemon aroma wonderfully.
Zero caffeine and wonderfully hydrating.

recipes.title: Golden Pineapple, Ginger & Steeped Sichuan Pepper Press
recipes.summary: Lively golden press uniting 100% pure pineapple juice, freshly squeezed ginger juice, lime, and a chilled clear toasted Sichuan pepper infusion.

ingredient_details.item: lightly toasted crushed Sichuan peppercorn husks

steps: Steep toasted crushed Sichuan pepper husks in 1/3 cup hot water 4 minutes and strain cleanly.
Combine strained floral infusion, pineapple juice, ginger juice, and lime juice over ice cubes.
Stir briskly and serve cold.
tips: Naturally sweet tropical pineapple balances the bright botanical notes with no added sugar.
Lovely splashed with plain sparkling water.

recipes.title: Chilled Sweet Pear, Lemon & Sichuan Pepper Orchard Press
recipes.summary: Gentle pure pear juice brightened with fresh lemon and a clear strained infusion of lightly toasted Sichuan peppercorn husks.

ingredient_details.item: lightly toasted crushed Sichuan peppercorn husks

steps: Steep toasted crushed Sichuan pepper husks in 1/3 cup hot water 4 minutes and strain through a fine filter.
Pour the clear aromatic infusion, pure pear juice, and lemon juice over ice cubes.
Stir gently and enjoy chilled.
tips: Mellow sweet pear lets the subtle citrus-flower aroma shine cleanly.
Naturally caffeine-free.

recipes.title: Ruby Tart Cherry & Steeped Sichuan Pepper Sparkling Tonic
recipes.summary: Jewel-red alcohol-free aperitif uniting 100% tart cherry juice, a clear strained toasted Sichuan pepper infusion, honey, and bubbly sparkling water.

ingredient_details.item: lightly toasted crushed Sichuan peppercorn husks

steps: Steep toasted crushed Sichuan pepper husks in 1/4 cup hot water 4 minutes, strain cleanly, and dissolve honey while warm.
Pour the fragrant infusion and tart cherry juice over ice cubes.
Top with chilled sparkling water, stir lightly, and serve immediately.
tips: Rich ruby antioxidants with a crisp citrus-floral sparkle and zero alcohol.
Substitute still chilled water if you prefer flat drinks.
